purpose: Confirm whether the recorded current-build GPU verification covers the current engine source after documentation-only follow-up commits.
command: git diff --name-only <gpu_verification_source_revision>..<audited_head_revision> -- crates Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml shaders assets
limitations: Source parity only; does not rerun or extend GPU, native-window, visual, performance, Windows/DX12, or other-adapter verification.
